BC_description: The `Help.wrap()` method has been removed and refactored into `formatItem()` and `boxWrap()` methods for better support of text styling and ANSI color sequences.
Adaptation_method: Replace calls to `Help.wrap()` with the new `boxWrap()` method for general text wrapping that properly handles ANSI escape sequences. For example, change `helper.wrap(commandDescription, helpWidth, 0)` to `helper.boxWrap(commandDescription, helpWidth)`. The `boxWrap()` method handles text wrapping with proper support for ANSI color sequences and no longer requires the third parameter (indent) that was present in the old `wrap()` method.
